narrative: From the tiring-house door. Kemp as Launce, a rope's end in his hand, nothing tied to it. The yard is beyond the door. The rope's end against the stage. No animal. He is still in the door.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood in the door, and did not go on.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Played Launce to an empty rope. He was not spoken with.

entities.name: The Two Gentlemen of Verona
entities.context: Shown on stage in An empty rope
